verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several selectable transcription options: Reverb ASR, Whisper Large (priced at $0.005/min) and human transcription (12–24 hour turnaround). That gives fragments of cost and latency information. However, no published accuracy figures or side-by-side comparison of tradeoffs between the models appear. missing for 10: published per-model accuracy metrics (e.g. WER), latency figures for the ASR models, a complete per-model pricing comparison, documentation of how to select a model via the API, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Free credits equivalent to 5 hours of Reverb ASR
The expected turnaround time is 12 to 24 hours for human transcription jobs.
